runtimeSettings.description: Hokkugo no Novera laato e foonduye MCP serverji.
runtimeSettings.toolCallTimeoutDesc: Ɗuuɗal wakkatiire nde ɗum laara dow MCP kuuɗe kuutinirɗe hidde wakkatiire nden wari.
runtimeSettings.maxToolOutputCharsDesc: Ɓurna wattam kuutinirgel juutngol e hoositiree nder konngol. Koo ɗume ko saali ka'a e hoositiree boo e hoositiree dow ɗum sankitiraama, ngam non wattam mawngal waawa laataaki ko fooɗii nder haala ka'a. Hoositiree yaago 0 ngam hoositiree wattam fuu.
runtimeSettings.smartToolRoutingDesc: To ɗum waɗaama, Novera suɓata ko haandi e MCP suɓooɓe bako ɓe hawta kuutiniraaɓe maɓɓe. Ɓaɓɓina ngam ɓe hawta kuutiniraaɓe maɓɓe fuu MCP.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModel: Ɗum naftori moodelwol ngol anndiraangol ngam waylugo.
runtimeSettings.useLightweightRouterModelDesc: To smart routing e huwiree, huwiree laawol routing e ko feerootira (ɓurna fuu e ɗum seɗɗa) moodel naa e moodel chat. Ɓaɓɓa ngam huuduki e moodel chat ɗum huwirata ngam routing.
runtimeSettings.routerModelDesc: Suɓii wadduɗo e moodel nder nokkuure go'o; moodelji ɗi seɗɗa tan e hoositiree ngam ɗaɓɓitugo e ɗaɓɓitugo.
runtimeSettings.routerModelEmptyList: Wala moodelji seɗɗa. Ɓesda moodel pamarngal ko boo hawta API keyji nder moodelji.
